children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 24, following a slew of corporate developments, block deal.

Shares of Pyramid Technoplast jumped more than 2% following the company received an amended Consolidated Consent and Authorisation (CCA) from the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB), enabling the company to receive, collect, store, transport, and recycle industrial packaging waste generated by other companies, including empty barrels, containers, and liners contaminated with hazardous chemicals/waste.

Rainbow Children's Medicare share price slipped 2% after company appointed Sudarshan Patodia as the Chief Financial Officer and key managerial personnel of the company and designated him as Group Chief Financial Officer, with effect from September 23.

Shares of Max Estates added 6% as company will enter into a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) for an approximately 9.76-acre land parcel in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, envisaging a super built-up development potential of around 1.5 million square feet and an estimated gross development value (GDV) of Rs 2,500-3,000 crore.
Concord Biotech share price rose 4% after company board approved the issuance of bonus shares in the proportion of one bonus equity share for every one share held by shareholders.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: Max Estates gains 6% on JDA; Concord Biotech rises 4% after bonus share approval
